sentences.en: On behalf of LP Clubs, I'd like to welcome you all here today.
sentences.zh: 我谨代表LP俱乐部，欢迎大家今天光临。

sentences.en: My name's Sandy Fisher and I'm one of the fitness managers here.
sentences.zh: 我叫桑迪·费舍尔，是这里的健身经理之一。

sentences.en: Before we start our tour of the club I'll just run through some basic information about the facilities we have here, including recent improvements, and explain the types of membership available.
sentences.zh: 在开始参观本俱乐部之前，我先简要介绍一下我们现有的设施，包括最近的改进项目，并说明目前提供的会员类型。

sentences.en: Our greatest asset is probably our swimming pool which at 25 metres isn't Olympic-sized, & 12 but now we've expanded it to eight lanes, it's much wider.
sentences.zh: 我们最宝贵的资产可能就是这座游泳池——虽然25米长并未达到奥运会标准，但如今我们已将其扩建为八条泳道，因此宽度大大增加。

sentences.en: This means there are rarely more than a couple of people at a time in each lane.
sentences.zh: 这意味着每条泳道通常同时最多只有两三人。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, there isn't space for an outdoor pool here but the glass roof on the swimming pool is partly retractable, which means you can enjoy something of the open-air experience on warmer days.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，此处没有空间建造室外泳池，但游泳池的玻璃屋顶部分可伸缩，因此在天气较暖的日子里，您仍能体验到些许户外氛围。

sentences.en: Our recently refurbished fitness suite has all the latest exercise equipment including ten & 12 new running machines, and a wide range of weight-training machines.
sentences.zh: 我们最近翻新过的健身区配备了全套最新健身器材，包括十台和十二台新型跑步机，以及种类繁多的力量训练器械。

sentences.en: Each member is given full training in how to operate the equipment and there is always a trainer on duty to offer help and advice.
sentences.zh: 每位会员均会接受全套设备操作培训，且健身区内始终有教练值班，随时提供帮助与建议。

sentences.en: Although we do have adult-only times after 6 and at certain times 6 at weekends, children are well catered for.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们确实在晚上6点之后及周末特定时段设有仅限成人的使用时间，但儿童也得到了充分关照。

sentences.en: Older children continue to benefit from a wide range of tuition; anything from trampolining to yoga.
sentences.zh: 年龄较大的儿童仍可享受丰富多样的课程指导，内容涵盖蹦床运动到瑜伽等各个方面。

sentences.en: One thing all our members appreciate about us is that we take very good care of them.
sentences.zh: 所有会员都非常欣赏我们的一点是：我们对会员关怀备至。

sentences.en: This starts on day one with your personal assessment.
sentences.zh: 这种关怀始于您入会的第一天——即您的个人健康评估。

sentences.en: You are asked to fill in a questionnaire giving details of any health problems.
sentences.zh: 您需填写一份问卷，详细说明任何健康问题。

sentences.en: One of our personal trainers will then go through this with you.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们的私人教练将与您一起审阅这份问卷。

sentences.en: The trainer will then take you through the safety rules for using the equipment in the fitness suite.
sentences.zh: 接着，教练会向您讲解健身区内各类器材的安全使用规则。

sentences.en: During your next exercise session a personal trainer will work with you to make sure you understand these.
sentences.zh: 在您下一次锻炼课程中，私人教练将亲自指导您，确保您完全理解这些规则。

sentences.en: It's very important to do this because we really do want to avoid Audioscripts having any sports injuries.
sentences.zh: 这一步骤至关重要，因为我们确实希望竭力避免任何运动伤害的发生。

sentences.en: There's a lot more to looking after yourself than simply lifting weights!
sentences.zh: 关爱自身健康远不止于举重锻炼！

sentences.en: At the end of the personal assessment, the trainer will draw up a plan, outlining what you should try to achieve within a six-week period.
sentences.zh: 在个人评估结束时，教练将制定一份计划，概述您在六周内应努力实现的目标。

sentences.en: This will then be reviewed at the end of the six weeks.
sentences.zh: 然后将在六周结束时对这份计划进行回顾。

sentences.en: Now, I'll just quickly run through the types of membership we have available.
sentences.zh: 现在，我将快速介绍一下我们目前提供的会员类型。

sentences.en: All members.
sentences.zh: 所有会员

sentences.en: must pay a joining fee of £90 in addition to the rates for the monthly membership fees.
sentences.zh: 除每月会员费外，还必须支付90英镑的入会费。

sentences.en: Gold membership entitles you to free entry at all LP Clubs.
sentences.zh: 黄金会员资格可让您免费进入所有LP俱乐部。

sentences.en: There are now LP clubs in all major cities and towns so if you travel a lot this will a be a great advantage.
sentences.zh: 目前，LP俱乐部已遍布所有主要城市和城镇，因此如果您经常出差，这将是一个巨大的优势。

sentences.en: Individual gold membership costs £50 a month and joint membership for you and your partner will cost £75.
sentences.zh: 个人黄金会员每月费用为50英镑，您与伴侣共同办理的联合会员则为75英镑。

sentences.en: Premier membership is for professional people whose work commitments make it difficult for them to use the club during the day and so LP gives booking preferences to Premier members at peak times.
sentences.zh: 白金会员面向职业人士，因其工作安排导致白天难以使用俱乐部，因此LP在高峰时段优先为白金会员提供预订服务。

sentences.en: This means you will find it easier to book the sessions at times that suit you.
sentences.zh: 这意味着您将更容易在适合您的时间预订课程。

sentences.en: Reciprocal arrangements with other LP Clubs are available to Premier members.
sentences.zh: 高级会员可享受与其他LP俱乐部的互惠安排。

sentences.en: Premier membership is for individuals only, but you will be sent passes for.
sentences.zh: 高级会员资格仅限个人申请，但您每月都会收到访客通行证。

sentences.en: guests every month.
sentences.zh: 访客每月都会收到通行证。

sentences.en: The monthly fee is £65.
sentences.zh: 每月费用为65英镑。

sentences.en: You don't have to have any special clothes or equipment when you visit the club.
sentences.zh: 您来俱乐部时无需准备任何特殊服装或设备。

sentences.en: We provide robes and hairdryers in the changing rooms, but it's very important to remember.
sentences.zh: 更衣室内我们提供浴袍和吹风机，但非常重要的一点是您必须记住

sentences.en: your photo card because you won't be able to get in without it.
sentences.zh: 您的照片卡，因为没有它您将无法进入。

sentences.en: For people who aren't working during the day then
sentences.zh: 对于白天不工作的人士而言
